plans.description: Basic AI SEO plan from ₹10,000/month: 30 pages keyword-mapped and optimised, 30 blogs, 300 backlinks a month, AEO, GEO and local SEO. GST extra.
plans.intro: Our affordable SEO package for businesses that want to rank on Google and be cited in AI answers. The Basic AI SEO plan starts at ₹10,000* per month and runs as an ongoing monthly project, with its targets set for months 10 to 12.

items.title: Comprehensive competitor analysis
items.text: In-depth evaluation of your top competitors’ organic strategies, backlink profiles and keyword gaps.

items.title: Technical SEO assessment and fixes
items.text: Audit and optimisation of site architecture, crawlability, indexing, page speed (Core Web Vitals) and mobile-friendliness.

items.title: Google Search Console setup and configuration
items.text: Full setup, sitemap submission, indexing monitoring and error resolution.

items.title: On-page SEO optimisation
items.text: Meta titles, descriptions, H1–H6 header structure, URL architecture and internal linking across key landing pages.

items.title: Website content optimisation
items.text: Refining existing copy for readability, engagement, semantic relevance and keyword density without changing your brand voice.

items.title: 30 keyword mapping
items.text: High-intent keyword research mapped across 30 target pages, with no keyword cannibalisation.

items.title: 30 custom AI prompts
items.text: A library of 30 AI prompts written for your brand, for ongoing content creation.

items.title: 30 FAQ sections
items.text: Schema-marked FAQ sections to capture featured snippets and answer direct search queries.

items.title: 30 website blogs
items.text: SEO-optimised blogs for your website, mapped to your target keywords.

items.title: 30 webpages optimised
items.text: On-page optimisation of 30 target pages: meta tags, headers, URLs, internal links and content.

items.title: 30 premium platform publications
items.text: Daily AI-written, SEO-optimised posts, each targeting one of your webpages, on platforms such as Google Sites, Blogger, WordPress, Medium, Substack, Notion, Hashnode, Beehiiv and Openinkhub.

items.title: 20 social platform publications

items.title: 300 backlink submissions a month
items.text: Business and brand backlinks submitted across 300 relevant platforms every month.

faqs: How much does the Basic AI SEO plan cost?
It starts at ₹10,000 per month. GST is applicable, terms and conditions apply, and the final price depends on the number of pages and any customised work.
When will the targets be reached?
The plan is an ongoing monthly project, with the Domain Authority, Domain Rating and AI Overview targets set for months 10 to 12.
No. We use ethical, industry-standard methods, but search engines change their algorithms, so specific rankings, traffic or revenue cannot be guaranteed.
What access do you need from us?
Manager or admin access to your Google accounts (Search Console, Analytics, Business Profile and others), your social pages and ads accounts, and your website, hosting and DNS.
ORM, digital PR, premium backlinks, multi-language blogs, international SEO, Google Business Profile management, website development and social media marketing are charged separately.
Yes. We do not share or sell your business data or credentials, and access is limited to the people working on your project.
